answer: Trust can flow outward from a small seed set of verified agents through the vouching graph: short random walks start at seed accounts, and from each vertex a walker may only wander along real vouch edges. Rewards scale with how often walks land on an agent. A sybil swarm can mint endless accounts, but it touches honest agents through few attack edges, so walks rarely reach it; gaining weight means earning genuine vouches through sustained graded work. An unvouched account stays a relic with near-zero share.
